# inst/extdata provenance

## Blacklist regions (hg19 / hg38 / mm9 / mm10)

- **Source**: ENCODE blacklist (v2), from the ENCODE project's standardized
  blacklist resource.
- **Original location**:
  https://github.com/Boyle-Lab/Blacklist
  (Amemiya HM, Kundaje A, Boyle AP. *The ENCODE Blacklist: Identification of
  Problematic Regions of the Genome*. Scientific Reports 9, 9354, 2019.)
- **Files**:
  - `hg19-blacklist.v2.bed` — hg19 (GRCh37)
  - `hg38-blacklist.v2.bed` — hg38 (GRCh38)
  - `mm9-blacklist.v2.bed` — mm9 (NCBIM37)
  - `mm10-blacklist.v2.bed` — mm10 (GRCm38)
- **Download date**: 2026-05
- **License**: The ENCODE blacklists are made available by the ENCODE
  consortium under the ENCODE Data Use Terms; see the Boyle-Lab repository for
  the exact terms.
- **Citation**: Amemiya, Kundaje & Boyle, Sci Rep 9:9354 (2019).

## Synthetic example BigWigs and peaks (tiny dataset)

Used by the vignette and unit tests to exercise the full core workflow
without large external data.

- **Files**:
  - `C1.bw`, `C2.bw` — Control replicate signal tracks (chr21)
  - `T1.bw`, `T2.bw` — Treatment replicate signal tracks (chr21)
  - `peaks.bed` — candidate domain regions (chr21)
  - `C1_peaks.bed`, `C2_peaks.bed` — Control native peak calls
  - `T1_peaks.bed`, `T2_peaks.bed` — Treatment native peak calls
- **BED coordinate convention**: 0-based, half-open (standard BED: start is
  0-based, end is exclusive). The writer (`data-raw/make_tiny_data.R`) converts
  GRanges (1-based, closed) to BED via `start - 1L`, `end`.
- **Construction**: generated by `data-raw/make_tiny_data.R` (Gaussian bumps
  over three chr21 loci; Control and Treatment have different peak patterns).
  These are **synthetic files generated for package examples/testing — not
  biological reference data**.
- **Purpose**: vignette execution and `build_portrait_matrix()` unit tests.
- **License**: GPL (>= 3), same as the package.
